entry.author: Sport New Zealand Ihi Aotearoa
entry.summary: Adele Millin, Business Director, The Research Agency (TRA)Sport and recreation organisations are woven into everyday rituals across Aotearoa – the Saturday morning game, the after-work training session, the annual club event that brings people together. Drawing on TRA research, this session explores why these moments matter and how they build connection and identity. Learn how to use this insight to strengthen relationships and tell more compelling stories to funders, decision-makers and media.
